animations.name: Medium Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE slow, deliberate, heavy crouching lunging medium punch across the entire clip (strictly one punch only — do not throw a jab first, do not punch twice), pure body motion only in completely empty air around the fighter: staying low on the ground baseline without standing up, she first takes her time winding up by coiling her torso and pulling her punching shoulder and fist back while loading her legs; then she smoothly lunges forward along the ground and extends ONE single heavy straight horizontal punch out to full reach (arm straight, fist closed, rear hand guarding her chest); she holds full extension briefly, then smoothly pulls back into the exact starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, curly hair, plaid shirt, jeans, footwear, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
